verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch documents the retrieval layer for RAG: semantic_text auto-embedding, an inference API, vector search over dense/sparse vectors, and hybrid full-text plus vector retrieval with RRF in one request. Its search docs explicitly list RAG systems as a target use case, so the story's 'retrieval APIs' path is covered. Missing for 10: any evidenced answer-generation or conversational/chat API (LLM completion over retrieved results), an end-to-end RAG tutorial, and independent or hands-on corroboration of RAG use.
